'''Traverse Parkway''' is one of the unnumbered Routes in Los Sengas. It runs within Peckern Continent, between Stone Shoal and Intus Occident.

History

Due to missing historical records, only the history of this road starting from 2022 will be recorded:

  • Beginning of 2022: Traverse Parkway began construction.
  • December 2022: Traverse Parkway completed construction between Nam Wui Section and Intus Occident Section.

Sections

As most of this road consisted of different reconstructed roads in Peckern Continent throughout different time periods, the sectioning of this road is highly complex, and most of the Sections are less than 2km long.

Nam Wui Section

Formerly as Yat Wah Road, it starts at the south of the junction with Gull Woods Road and Stone Shoal Road, traverses through residential buildings in the Peckern Sub-District and ends at Chu Ka Wui Road. Exits accessing the Peckern Viaduct will be added in the future. This Section is 1.5 km long.

Chung Wui Section

Formerly Grand Squirrel Boulevard and Proyga Road to the east of Congorge. It starts at Chu Ka Wui Road, passes through the Peckern Continent Sign to the north of the Peckern Triangle and run parallel with the bus rapid transit system "GreenLink", and ends at the entrance of the Congorge Tunnel. Moreover, a bus terminus is set up near Grand Squirrel Checkpoint, but the buses could only exit the Bus Terminus on its East end. This Section is 1.8 km long.

Congorge Section

This Section includes the Congorge Tunnel and ends at Proyga Stadium Road. Starting from this section, the Traverse Parkway becomes the newly built roadways. This Section assists Proyga Road in diverting traffic and is one of the shortest sections of Traverse Parkway at just 0.6 km long.

Proyga Section

This Section starts at the Proyga Stadium Road and ends at Tai Hing Road. This Section is also a section that parted from Congorge Section, and is the third shortest section in the Traverse Parkway at 1 km long.

Polywood Section

This Section starts at Tai Hing Road and ends at the Xofa North Link. It passes through the north of Landaiyo Shopping Mall, and is 1.3 km long. Buses at the BRT System could use the westbound part of this section, and it is 1.3 km long.

Intus Occident Section

This Section is the Traverse Parkway to the west of Xofa North Link to divert traffic that does not run within Peckern. As a result, the Intus Occident Gateway Road has been converted into a dead end to contain buses and traffic to and from the Gateway. The junction with Seventy Years Avenue will also be reconstructed in the future to make improvements on traffic safety. This Section is one of the shortest sections of Traverse Parkway at just 0.6 km long.

  • Stone Shoal
  • Peckern

  • Intus Occident
